As of today (July 13, 2026): a domestic large accelerated filer must file its Form 10‑K within 60 days after the end of its fiscal year. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/final/33-8644.pdf?utm_source=openai))

Controlling SEC source: "Revisions to Accelerated Filer Definition and Accelerated Deadlines for Filing Periodic Reports" (SEC Final Rule, Release No. 33‑8644). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/final/33-8644.pdf?utm_source=openai))

(For context: accelerated filers generally have a 75‑day 10‑K deadline and non‑accelerated filers 90 days. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/divisions/corpfin/cffinancialreportingmanual.pdf?utm_source=openai)))
